newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian financier has 10.65 of CIR.
newsitem.headline: Italian financier has 10.65 of CIR.

text.p: Italian financier Luigi Giribaldi has raised his stake in industrial holding company CIR to 10.65 Per cent, CIR said in a statement on Thursday.
The statement said Giribaldi had 59,962,500 ordinary shares which were being held on his behalf by Banque du Gothard (Monaco).

The bank now held a total of 60,827,500 CIR shares, equivalent to 10.8 percent of the company's ordinary stock, the statement said, but did specify who owned the balance of the shares which were not Giribaldi's.
Carlo De Benedetti still controls CIR with an unchanged stake of 50.83 percent of the company's capital. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
